WHAT_IS_LOCKED_TODAY_DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY.selected_observable: count of live red agents within 4.0 cells of blue's own flag
WHAT_IS_LOCKED_TODAY_DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY.selection_criterion: lowest pooled misclassification rate (minimize-pooled-misclassification, exhaustive scan) among four radii tested {4,6,8,10} on full-episode means, 16 seeds/pole
WHAT_IS_LOCKED_TODAY_DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY.status_of_these_numbers: DESCRIPTIVE. They establish that pressure-within-4-cells is the right observable. They are NOT the online selector's threshold. A full-episode-average statistic and any bounded trailing-window statistic are different random variables; carrying 0.60625 forward to a windowed feature without re-deriving it on that same statistic would be exactly the kind of unvalidated threshold this project's discipline exists to prevent.

WHAT_REMAINS_A_CALIBRATION_QUANTITY_NOT_: the per-tick decision threshold (re-derived separately for each candidate W on the windowed statistic itself)

stage_A_calibration_grid_outcome_blind.data: the SAME 32 episodes already collected (16 seeds/pole, smoke family 99900101-99900116, fixed composition 2A_2D, both poles) -- reused as calibration data, not new evidence, no registry interaction
stage_A_calibration_grid_outcome_blind.per_tick_feature: recompute the radius=4.0 pressure count at every tick (not just the episode mean) for all 32 episodes
stage_A_calibration_grid_outcome_blind.windowed_statistic: for window W, at tick t: mean of the per-tick feature over ticks max(0, t-W+1) .. t. No fallback branch: when t < W-1, this is simply the mean over the available history 0..t, per the no-forced-default requirement below.
stage_A_calibration_grid_outcome_blind.per_window_threshold: for EACH W, independently re-run the exact same minimize-pooled-misclassification scan used for the radius selection, but pooled over every (episode, tick) pair's windowed value in the calibration set -- never inherit 0.60625
stage_A_calibration_grid_outcome_blind.hysteresis_grid: band half-width m in {0.0, 0.05, 0.10, 0.15}, applied symmetrically around that window's own re-derived threshold (upper = threshold + m, lower = threshold - m; composition holds between the two bounds)
stage_A_calibration_grid_outcome_blind.dwell_grid: minimum ticks between switches d in {4, 10, 20, 40}. d=4 is not arbitrary: it equals macro_commit_go_to_ticks, the existing production commitment horizon, included specifically so the tie-break can prefer tying dwell to a timescale the system already has a reason for, per the alternative the PI proposed, rather than a freestanding convention.
stage_A_calibration_grid_outcome_blind.no_forced_default: eliminated as a judgment call. There is no separate fallback composition for an unfilled window; the mean-over-available-history value is used from tick 0 onward and classified by the same rule as every other tick.

stage_B_frozen_tie_break_declared_before.primary: minimum PER-TICK pooled misclassification rate on the calibration set, computed identically to the radius-selection criterion
stage_B_frozen_tie_break_declared_before.tie_band: any (W, threshold, m, d) configuration whose error is within 0.02 (2 percentage points) of the grid minimum is considered tied
stage_B_frozen_tie_break_declared_before.secondary_within_tie_band: minimum mean number of composition switches per episode on the calibration set (the chatter rate)
stage_B_frozen_tie_break_declared_before.tertiary_if_still_tied: prefer d = 4 (the macro-commit-horizon-aligned dwell) over any other value; if still tied, prefer the smallest W
stage_B_frozen_tie_break_declared_before.rule: This ordering is fixed now. It is not reweighted after seeing the grid.

stage_C_held_out_validation.data: a FRESH, disjoint smoke block never used in stage A -- seeds 99900201-99900216, 16/pole, same fixed composition 2A_2D, same poles
stage_C_held_out_validation.procedure: apply the ONE configuration selected by stage B, exactly as frozen, to the held-out episodes. No re-fitting, no threshold adjustment.
reported: held-out fraction of episodes with at least one switch
held-out per-episode dominant-composition accuracy (the composition the rule spends the most ticks in, compared to the true pole)
stage_C_held_out_validation.why_a_separate_block: stage A's numbers are calibration-set performance and will optimistically overfit the grid choice. Held-out performance is the honest estimate this project needs before sizing an outcome experiment.

stage_D_revised_outcome_n.not_computed_here: n is deliberately NOT frozen in this amendment.
stage_D_revised_outcome_n.method_once_held_out_error_is_known: expected_selector_gain ≈ (1 - e_held_out) * oracle_gain, where oracle_gain is the already-measured PYQUATICUS_4V4_ORACLE_COMPOSITION_RESULT.json contrast per pole. This is an approximation (it assumes a wrong-composition tick performs like the wrong FIXED arm, which is not exactly true for a within-episode switcher, only for a per-episode dominant-composition classifier) and will be stated as such, not as an exact power calculation.
stage_D_revised_outcome_n.consequence_flagged_now: the oracle-only projection already gave n ~= 192-256 for a comfortable Pole-A margin at the full oracle effect size. Any e_held_out > 0 shrinks the usable effect and therefore inflates the required n above that floor. The exact number is deferred, not guessed.

OUTCOME_BLIND_ENFORCEMENT: No score, win, reward, return, or draw field is read, computed, printed, or serialized anywhere in stages A-C. Only the declared feature, the true pole label (used solely to score classification error, never as a selector input), tick index, and switch counts are touched.

SEED_ACCOUNTING.holdout_seeds_99900201_99900216: smoke family, freshly spent for this amendment's stage C, no registry entry
